title: Definitely worth the trip...
text: Definitely worth the trip to see.  One of the most interesting spots during our trip.  Beautiful.  Wellworth it.
author: Linda_H

title: Highly recommend
text: Jose our tour guide was great. He gave us all the info we needed for a short visit with plenty of options of what we wanted to see. I also liked the liqueur and cookies but silly that we had to choose - it was not as big a deal as described. Overall I would highly recommend. This is my 3rd trip to Barcelona and I am so happy I finally made the time to do this. Next time, the train to the top or walk the mission trail to the cross. Thank you.
author: anitafZ2993WC

title: Worth the trip, book the side quests in advance
text: Meeting place directions were spot-on, and Rafael did a tremendous job of setting us up for success. The bus ride was comfortable, and the guide on the bus speakers was funny and informative. Montserrat was pleasant and charming, and the views of the surrounding mountains were striking. We saw the black Madonna and went up the Santa Joao funicular, both of which were an extra charge that we didn’t expect, but that could’ve been our misunderstanding.
author: Nickole_D

title: I wish I had known about...
text: This was a fantastic tour to Monserrat with the cogwheel train and Black Madonna. Jose our tour guide was great. He provides information and interesting history along the whole tour. Lots of free time to see and explore.
author: Anita_F

title: Scenic Views and Sacred Moments at Montserrat
text:
Our day trip to Montserrat was truly unforgettable. The entire experience with Julia Travel was seamless and well-organized, making it easy to simply enjoy the day.

Jonathan, our guide, was fantastic. He was engaging, knowledgeable, and thoughtful in how he brought the history and significance of Montserrat to life. What stood out most, though, were the incredible views. The scenery is absolutely breathtaking, and there’s a peacefulness to the mountain that you feel the moment you arrive.

title: Great tour for a group
text: A great tour for our group of 11, across 3 families and a mix of adults and 3 kids.  Highly recommend the afternoon tour as the monastery was next to empty and the sunset lighting was great.  The only drawback was that the restaurants and gift shops were closed by the time we were ready to use them.  Taking the train did add to the waiting time, but made for a relaxing trip.
author: John_K

title: Great ecperience
text: We were met by our guide Marta at the prearranged area, she guided us through all the necessary steps to arrive at our location and told us interesting facts about the surrounding area on our way to Monserrat. She is very knowledgeable on Monserrat and gave us plenty of time to explore the church and area. Marta is a wonderful guide!!
author: Jackie_R

title: Beautiful visit of Montesserat fabulous guide
text:
Martha is a very personable and knowledgeable person
We very much enjoyed our visit and her company
Thank you Martha
Marie Paule & Louis. From Canada

title: Definitely bring clothes you would hike in!
text: Great tour- lots of heavy walking and light hiking - great guide and we had tons of info from her around the area and the locations we visited.
author: Beachmerry

title: Extraordinary, and too much to see in one day.
text: Much too much to see in one day. make sure you book in the morning if you want to see the boys choir. The trail/ walk to St Michael's cross is very long and took up most of our time.
author: John202R
